question: Can source-witnessed quadratic causal relations be actually compiled into existing Yggdrasil native numeric checkpointed weights, survive interference and cold restore, and improve unseen causal composition without a conventional oracle at readout time? What happens under undeclared cubic changes?
hypothesis: With a full-rank 16-input public intervention design, existing NativeContextAccumulator(max_degree=2) will compile degree-2 source consequences into persistent checkpoint weights, forecast unseen inputs on in-family two-interaction worlds, and match independent GF(2)/exact 2880 Bayesian controls. Four source-only calibration witnesses should reject most out-of-family degree-3 counterexamples. No claim of superiority over the identical conventional mathematical class.

predecessor_evidence.classification: CKAD30 native sparse repair primary NO-GO; retained exact Bayesian grammar Brier 0.0, native sparse 0.26736
CKAD31 safe but undercovered native readout, pilot SCREEN_NO_GO
CKAD32 causal tournaments: information acquisition gains do not improve native representation; frozen SCREEN_NO_GO

inputs.name: fresh independent deterministic public synthetic source interventions
inputs.sha256: source_lock.json and Git blob fixed before pilot first-use
inputs.source: Original generated binary causal-world observations; SHA is identity only, not authentication of real-world causal truth

frozen_design.mode: Isolated external research. Use unchanged native NativeContextAccumulator numeric stage_update(max_degree=2), ordinary NativeCumulativeLearner and optional existing sparse repair as controls; absolutely no edits to accepted native code, model weights of owner, controller or protected first-use. Conventional degree-2 class assumption disclosed and not treated as learned structure.
frozen_design.worlds: In-class three independent 5-bit Boolean primitives each intercept XOR linear mask XOR two distinct pairwise terms (known declared 2880 grammar). Negative controls three additional primitives from same family XOR one independently selected cubic term, outside the degree-2 class. Six independent pressure slots with same in-class generator, no held leakage. Source generator hidden law IDs restricted to environment reveal/evaluator.
frozen_design.source_split: For each seed choose 16 distinct context/action inputs by an outcome-free deterministic greedy GF(2) rank-increasing design over all 32 publicly enumerable 5-bit inputs for degree-2 basis (16 features). Select four further disjoint calibration inputs using fixed SHA-keyed order; other 12 are held. Same 16+4 public input identities shared by all arms and both world families. Class selection degree=2 is explicit inductive bias; NOT discovery from source.
frozen_design.training: Native compiled candidate for three in-class + three OOD negative slots: stage_update through existing native 16-slot context accumulator at max_degree=2 with only the first 16 witnessed outcomes. Its numeric context checkpoint includes coefficients and source support, not hidden rule identity. Four additional public outcomes are used strictly as conservative calibration admission gate, not included in candidate fit or held score. If any calibration mismatch, the slot must abstain on *all* held inputs. Fit unmodified NativeCumulativeLearner and existing opt-in sparse control on the exact 20 public in-class rows (all equally disclosed). Fit conventional degree-2 GF(2) source-span model on same 16 fit inputs with same calibration gate, direct exact 2880 Bayesian posterior from all 20 public witnesses, conventional polynomial logistic on all 20 and smoothed frequency/sham. For OOD also fit a separate degree<=3 GF(2) source-span control on 20 witnesses.
frozen_design.retention: Append six separate pressure native slots (16 public witnesses each) to the same compiled native accumulator. Cold restore exact numeric checkpoint, byte and full 32-input readout parity for all six old slots, witness source ledger preserved and contradictory append must fail atomically without corrupting existing slot or siblings.
frozen_design.budgets: Per pilot seed 3 in-family old slots x20 witnessed interventions +3 out-of-class negative slots x20 +6 pressure slots x16=216 source consequences. Held 12 unseen x3 public Boolean graphs x2 families=72 held composites per arm per seed. Original 16 source witnesses per target slot, 4 source-only calibration, 12 held. No extra action or outcome for models; conditional readout evaluated offline and separately.
controls: No held consequences in rank design, fitting, class admission or calibration
Identical source input/action/consequence identities for each matched arm and context pressure
GF2 conventional baseline trained on exact 16 witnesses, calibrated identically, plus in-class complete 2880-law Bayesian posterior on 20 source records
OOD cubic shift with the same source budget, record calibration failure and any confidently wrong accepted extrapolations
Unmodified native full degree and original opt-in sparse repair; no hidden family oracle supplied to candidate
Cold checkpoint, input-only learned support/coefficients, exact pre/post interference readout equality
Fail-closed duplicate/conflicting source append, untouched sibling bytes and unchanged accepted main
frozen_design.scoring: Brier mean over 12 held inputs x3 disclosed graphs, per family (in-class vs OOD) and per seed. Predictions on abstention use probability 0.5, never free exclusions. Held primitive prediction coverage, confidently incorrect committed predictions, OOD false admission and calibration specificity, exact Bayes/GF2 regret. Full source/action counts and wall/cpu/rank/size. Conventional exact GF2 parity is an expected confound, not a native scientific advantage.
frozen_design.computation: One screened first-use for each of two pilot seeds 13531/13532 on GitHub-hosted CPU; existing MILP repair capped 30s and 100000 nodes per old native slot; no paid APIs, owner runners or GPU. After original receipts, full Linux/Windows final regression on exact candidate and independent read-only audit. No primary if pilot fails.
frozen_design.pilot_gate: ENGINEERING_FEASIBLE if BOTH pilots show in-class compiled native Brier <=0.01, >=0.10 absolute better than unchanged native on held composition, cold+interference+conflict integrity PASS, identical predictions to independent conventional GF2, in-class coverage >=0.95, OOD gated Brier <= uncalibrated compiled OOD Brier, zero wrong confidently predicted OOD bits after gate, and >=2 of 3 OOD slots rejected per seed. Otherwise SCREEN_NO_GO or INVALID on custody failure. Scientific superiority cannot pass because strong GF2/complete Bayes control has same declared class.
frozen_design.primary_policy: Primary seeds 23531/23532/23533 remain unused unless a new independent, preregistered scientific mechanism improves beyond fully fitted conventional GF2/exact posterior under matched information/actions/compute and has separate acceptance authority. Do not automatically run primary because an expected conventional-class compilation passes engineering feasibility.
frozen_design.environment: CPython 3.12, numpy 2.3.5 scipy 1.16.3 scikit-learn 1.8.0 joblib 1.5.2 threadpoolctl 3.6.0; hosted Linux pilot + Linux/Windows qualification.

classification_rules.supported: ENGINEERING_FEASIBLE if the exact pilot gate succeeds; scientific classification remains DEVELOPMENT_CONVENTIONAL_EQUIVALENCE, SCIENTIFIC_PASS=false, do not merge/promote. Mark native persistence mechanism validated in isolated synthetic engineering only, not actual open-world causal learning.
classification_rules.mixed: DEVELOPMENT_MIXED if native held Brier improves but either calibrated OOD or comparison gate fails with complete source custody. Stop without reserved primary.
classification_rules.negative: SCREEN_NO_GO if both pilots valid but not fully feasible. Retain negative; no primary or post-result tuning.
classification_rules.invalid: INVALID on any source identity/rank/calibration/held leakage, incorrect primitive parity control, fewer than 2880 exact in-class grammar laws, test/seed drift, failed cold persistence or contradiction atomicity, mismatched witness budgets, missing cross-OS regression. Infrastructure failures separately classified.

preregistration_note: Frozen BEFORE first implementation or pilot source readout. Synthetic class-pinned degree2 compilation is engineering feasibility, not proven Yggdrasil native degree discovery or scientific advantage.
